body:
Thank you all for attending today! Here are the notes from this meeting (the next one is at https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/9432):

### Agenda  
Attendees: Joey Arhar, Panos Astithas, Mason Freed, Brian Kardell, Anne van Kesteren, Olli Pettay, Simon Pieters
1. Review past action items
    1. Domenic to write up a response for [Accessibility Attribute Request](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/9084) focused on: is there implementer interest? And the general question of dashes in attribute names.
        1. Done.
    1. Google folks to collect some statistics on how often various queue lengths are overflowed around the [BroadcastChannel + bfcache proposal](https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/8972#issuecomment-1512292547). Anne will check if we can move forward with evicting on implementation-defined queue limit exceeded, with 2/3 support and 1 not-persuaded but not strongly objecting.
        1. Done.
1. Carryovers from last time
    1. [Brian] [Update the :dir / directionality to include shadow dom](https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/9166) (was [Tests for directionality and shadow DOM](https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/pull/29820))
        1. Olli will take a look at the latest changes. Mason and Joey will take another review pass.
    1. [Anne] [Reference even more baseline concepts in CSS Inline Layout](https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/5826)
        1. Mason will find someone from Chrome to review.
1. New topics
    1. [Panos] It would be great if people could RSVP to the calendar invite before the meeting so we know who to wait for.
    1. [Mason] Can we prioritize/list the important [open issues](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues?q=is%3Aissue+is%3Aopen+label%3A%22topic%3A+popover%22) for Popover?
        1. Mason will add the "addition/proposal" label to the non-blocking ones.
        1. Anne appreciates anyone who helps triage such issues by adding "addition/proposal" when appropriate.
    1. [Panos] Meeting at TPAC. 
        1. Panos to ask the CSS and a11y folks if they want to meet jointly and file an issue with a proposed agenda.

### Action Items

1. @smaug---- will take a look at the latest changes in [Update the :dir / directionality to include shadow dom](https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/9166). @mfreed7 and @josepharhar will take another review pass.
1. @mfreed7 will find someone from Chrome to review [Reference even more baseline concepts in CSS Inline Layout](https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/5826).
1. @mfreed7 will add the "addition/proposal" label to the non-blocking [issues for Popover](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues?q=is%3Aissue+is%3Aopen+label%3A%22topic%3A+popover%22).
1. @past to ask the CSS and a11y folks if they want to meet jointly at TPAC and file an issue with a proposed agenda.
